A class of large '''transport''' was active during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="Aldhani" /> In [[13 BBY]],<ref name="Solo date">According to ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', [[Han Solo]] enlisted in the [[Imperial Academy]] 9 [[Standard year|years]] after the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places in [[22 BBY]]. Therefore, it can be deduced that Solo joined the Academy in [[13 BBY]].</ref> as [[Han Solo|Han]] and [[Qi'ra]] were fleeing the [[White Worms]] on [[Corellia]], one such [[transport]] flew through the [[atmosphere]] near [[Coronet City Spaceport|Coronet Spaceport]].<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> [[Standard year|Years]] later in [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Andor Date">{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}} takes place shortly after "[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]]," which dates itself to [[5 BBY]].</ref> at least one transport's wreckage was being scrapped at the [[north side yard]] on [[Ferrix]] near a [[Pelta-class frigate|''Pelta''-class frigate]], and shortly after two transports landed at a spaceport on [[Coruscant]] as [[Syril Karn]] traveled to the residence of [[Eedy Karn]] following the [[Ambush on Ferrix|Ferrix incident]].<ref name="Aldhani" />
{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The transport first appeared in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'',<ref name="Solo" /> with concept art of the transport created by [[Brett Northcutt]] and featured in ''[[The Art of Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>
